name: SnowbeltTech - Form/call - Google Sheets and SMS

parameters.content:
## Setup after import

1. Open **Normalize and Configure** and replace the owner phone, Twilio number, and Google Sheet ID placeholders.
2. Confirm that the SMS consent text exactly matches the checkbox on snowbelttech.com.
3. Select your Google Sheets credential in both Google Sheets nodes.
4. Select your Twilio credential in both Twilio nodes.
5. Open each Google Sheets node and refresh the **Inquiries** sheet columns.
6. Test with the Webhook Test URL, then activate the workflow and use the Production URL on the website.

Customer SMS is sent only when a valid US phone number and SMS consent are both present. The owner alert is always attempted after the inquiry is stored.
